report_comment.text: STRN encodes striatin, a scaffold in signaling complexes including STRIPAK. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. STRN exon3 fused to ALK exon20 has been confirmed in lung adenocarcinoma. The product retains the STRN coiled-coil and ALK kinase regions; the reported patient responded to crizotinib. ALK-directed treatment is supported by the ALK-positive NSCLC indication; the cited evidence for this particular partner is a case report.
